title: Incident response: lessons learned and postmortem

videos.script: The incident is closed. The systems work. Everybody wants to forget it. {{closed}} This lesson is the one meeting that makes the next incident cheaper. It starts with numbers: how long each step took, measured from the logs and the record, not from memory. {{numbers}} Then the causes, and there is always more than one. A review that ends with a name ends there. {{causes}} Then actions, each with an owner, a date and a way to check it is done. And the last phase writes the first one: what the review finds becomes the next preparation. {{loop}}
